fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami-area rents and landlords, streetcar and traffic safety, and proposed traffic improvements; reports and bulletins on municipal matters including gasoline pump inspections and the resignation petition of Dade County justices of the peace; coverage of Miami–Bahamas (Nassau) tourism and trade; entertainment and nightlife listings and advertisements for clubs, dances, and theaters; and substantial promotional and news content concerning Florida oil prospects and related investment ventures.
